lines.t: The best-selling game of all time started as one man's side project, called Cave Game.
Minecraft has sold over 400 million copies. No other game in history comes close.
The idea is simple. The whole world is made of blocks. Break them, collect them, and build anything.
A Swedish programmer known as Notch built the first version in about a week, in May 2009.
He posted it on a small indie forum on May 17th, 2009.

sc.sub: first posted on an indie forum

lines.t: The Creeper was an accident. Notch was trying to model a pig, and mixed up the height and the length.
Composer C418 made the spider sounds from a recording of a fire hose.
It officially launched in 2011. Three years later, Microsoft bought it for 2.5 billion dollars.
By 2021, 140 million people were playing every month.
On YouTube, Minecraft videos have been watched over a trillion times.
Schools even use a special edition to teach coding.
Last year's Minecraft Movie became the second highest grossing video game movie ever.
Last year it finally got a modern graphics mode, called Vibrant Visuals.
And the game does have an ending. Beat the Ender Dragon, and the credits roll.

sc.label: THE END: THE FINAL BOSS ARENA

lines.t: It's still growing. A Switch 2 version arrives October 27th, and a brand new dimension is planned for 2027.
Fun fact: in 2011, it beat The Binding of Isaac for best indie game.

sc.sub: it beat The Binding of Isaac
